name: Hosanna
overview: The term 'Hosanna' is presented in Scripture as a Jewish acclamation expressing praise and a plea for salvation, notably directed toward Jesus as the Son of David and the promised King. The crowds joyfully proclaim 'Hosanna' during His triumphal entry, recognizing Him as the one who comes in the name of the Lord and blessing the kingdom of David (Matthew 21:9, Mark 11:9-10, John 12:13). This acclamation highlights both the messianic expectation and the acknowledgment of Jesus' divine authority, even as it provokes opposition from religious leaders (Matthew 21:15).
